authority_bind.lemma11_L2_source: CSZ Paper II, Lemma 11 final L1/L2 coverage proof, printed p.13

source_exact_L2.active_definition: color c is active for 3-list L and extension d iff some v in Y'∩N(Y0') has list L and d(v)=c
source_exact_L2.L1_role: covers extensions having at most one active color in every 3-list class
source_exact_L2.L2_entry: choose L0 with at least two active colors, y1,y2 in Y'_{L0}∩N(Y0'), and their colors c1,c2
source_exact_L2.source_Z: for each L'!=L0, Z(L') contains v in Y'_{L'} having a nonneighbor n in {y1,y2} whose chosen color belongs to L'
source_exact_L2.source_forced_color: g(v) is the unique element of L'\L0
source_exact_L2.source_acceptability_step: acceptability is used only at final coverage to infer c(v) in L'\L0 and hence c(v)=g(v)

escape_definitions.ESCAPE_c: v in Z(L') with c(v) in L'∩L0; equivalently the source equality c(v)=g(v) fails
escape_definitions.SURVIVING_ESCAPE: an escape vertex that, after adding y1,y2 to the seed and source-native Lemma10 normalization, remains a 3-list Y-vertex and still has a neighbor in the residual Y0
escape_definitions.VI_MULTI_CLASS_SURVIVOR: after seed-two+Lemma10, vertices from at least two distinct 3-list classes remain in Y∩N(Y0); this is exactly the remaining obstruction to axiom (vi)

reason: each 3-list class therefore has only one active color
the extension is covered by an L1 branch; there is no L0 with two active colors
sealed_8_vertex_C11.consequence: The 8-vertex acceptability counterexample is not a witness of the final L2 coverage hole.

derivation: a1,a2 are two active colors in L0, so L1 cannot cover this extension.
b1 is nonadjacent to both a1,a2 and both selected colors 3,4 belong to L(b1), hence b1 is in Z(L(b1)).
Source L2 sets g(b1)=the unique element of {1,3,4}\{2,3,4}={1}.
The legal extension has c(b1)=3, so c(b1)!=g(b1).
Thus the unmodified source L2 construction does not cover this extension once acceptability is removed.

statement: For arbitrary q, choose a1=3,a2=4,z=1 and color every B_q vertex independently by 3 or 4.
Every B_q vertex is a literal ESCAPE_c for the source L2 rule, yielding 2^q extension color patterns.
However the selected A vertices hit the unique Y0 vertex z. After seed-two normalization the residual Y0 is empty, so axiom (vi) is vacuous.
Therefore exponential extension multiplicity does not imply exponential repair-family size.

candidate_repair.name: L2_SEED_TWO_THEN_LEMMA10
construction: Enumerate the same constant number of 3-list choices L0, ordered y1,y2 pairs, and c1,c2 choices as source L2.
Add only y1,y2 with colors c1,c2 to the seed; do not precolor Z(L') vertices.
Treat this as a normal subcase and apply the already source-native Lemma 10 normalization.

proved_by_source_contract.extension_coverage: PASS: for any extension with two active colors, choose witnesses y1,y2 with their actual colors; the extension extends this seed-two subcase, and Lemma10 equivalence preserves existence/reconstruction.
proved_by_source_contract.family_bound: PASS: at most 4*9*n^2 seed-two branches per P' before the <=1 Lemma10 output; polynomial.
proved_by_source_contract.seed_bound: PASS_SOURCE_NATIVE: only two vertices are added before the same Lemma10 machinery already used inside Lemma 11.
proved_by_source_contract.normal_subcase: PASS by the normal-subcase definition; each selected y_i already has a seed neighbor because it has a 3-list.
proved_by_source_contract.reconstruction: PASS by Lemma10 reconstruction composed with forgetting the two newly fixed seed vertices.

unresolved.vi: UNRESOLVED: Lemma10 preserves (vi) when already present but does not create it in general. Need to prove that after seed-two normalization at most one 3-list class meets residual Y0, or find a source-valid P7 counterexample.

arbitrary_N_killer_question.exact_form: Can VI_MULTI_CLASS_SURVIVOR occur in a P7-free legal C11/Paper-II state after L2_SEED_TWO_THEN_LEMMA10?
arbitrary_N_killer_question.if_no: PASS candidate: (vi) follows with no Z-color guessing, giving polynomial local L2 repair.
arbitrary_N_killer_question.if_yes: Preserve the first source-valid counterexample and test whether bounded representatives/forced propagation/polynomial compression can eliminate it; do not auto-invent a global descriptor.
arbitrary_N_killer_question.natural_two_class_adversarial_calibratio: A direct attempt to keep two distinct post-seed 3-list classes attached to separate residual-Y0 witnesses creates an induced P7 in the minimal source-shaped construction. Calibration only; not a theorem.
